VI.description: Creates the rectangular region (x1\2C y1)-(x2\2C y2) through gdi32.dll CreateRectRgn (stdcall\2C called in any thread). 0\2C 0\2C 0\2C 0 gives an EMPTY region - given to a window with user32 SetWindowRgn.vi it makes the window invisible on screen while it stays open\2C functional and capturable with PrintWindow (measured on a LabVIEW menu). A region handed to SetWindowRgn belongs to the system afterwards\3B any other region must be deleted with gdi32 DeleteObject.vi. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: error in\2C or the Call Library Function Node's own error.
